label: team_0170_head_teacher_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, here you are, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_02
text: I wanted to thank you for all your hard work in\nresolving the situation with Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_03
text: If not for you, I suspect I would have done the\nteam a grievous injustice in my choice of\r\npunishment for their actions.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_04
text: You have my sincere gratitude.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_system_01
text: *knock knock knock*

label: team_0170_head_teacher_05
text: Who is it?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_botan_01
text: Um... It’s Penny.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_06
text: Ah, Miss Penny! Do come in.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_botan_00
text: H-hello, Director.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_botan_02
text: About the STCs... I’d like to work on them\ntogether with the rest of Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_07
text: That’s wonderful news. Thank you very much\nfor your favorable response.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_08
text: But, um...I...I should be punished more heavily\nthan the others, I think...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_09
text: Why so? Because of Operation Starfall?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_botan_03
text: No, not that. Because of the other really bad\nthing I did...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_10
text: And what would that be?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_botan_04
text: Um... Y’know the LP I gave you both in exchange\nfor helping me with Operation Starfall...?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_botan_05
text: I got hold of it sort of...illegally...by hacking the\nPokémon League’s LP management system.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_11
text: Ah. I see. That is...quite the revelation.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_12
text: I did not think such a thing was even possible\nin the first place.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_botan_06
text: It wasn’t all that har— Errr, I mean...I’m really\nsorry and I won’t do it again.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_13
text: Hmm. This matter is rather out of my jurisdiction,\nI’m afraid.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_head_teacher_15
text: I will have to consult Ms. Geeta, the Pokémon\nLeague chairwoman, on how best to proceed.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: team_0170_botan_07
text: I figured as much...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
